Sophia Learning

Take self-paced courses with a monthly membership. See which ones fit your degree before you enroll.

Browse Sophia courses

Choose a degree plan to see where specific courses fit.

See where 45 Sophia courses count in researched degree plans

Study format
Asynchronous and self-paced; ordinarily two active courses at a time. Written/project grading can affect completion.
Pricing
Published monthly price is $99 before applicable tax; longer subscriptions are available. Official pages disagree about the annual price, so verify checkout.
Assessments
Open-book assessments without proctored exams. Identity verification may be required. Written or project Touchstones and lab activities depend on the course.
Credit type
ACE recommendations for designated courses; a recommendation is not automatic university credit.
Transfer and enrollment details

How the credit works

ACE recommendations for designated courses; a recommendation is not automatic university credit.

Before enrolling

  • Start with your degree plan to see the proposed receiving course or requirement.
  • Review any course-specific enrollment, equipment or assessment steps shown in your plan.
  • University decisions about your own records remain separate from published course matches.
